agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/engine/statement_splitter.py: StatementSplitter._handle_nested_block had an inverted condition `if not (unified == 'WHILE')` that should have been `if unified == 'WHILE'`. The inverted check caused the method to always return 0 before ever reaching the LOOP/DO/IF/CASE block-start detection logic, breaking nested block/statement splitting for CASE/WHEN, IF, LOOP, FOR/WHILE, and DECLARE/BEGIN constructs - matching the reported regressions (issue193, issue194, casewhen splitting, and 6 more). Corrected the condition to `if unified == 'WHILE':` and verified via manual testing with CREATE PROCEDURE/FUNCTION bodies containing CASE/WHEN, FOR...LOOP, and IF...END IF blocks, all of which now split correctly as single statements.
